newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 588 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 588 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 588 contracts, compared with 489 contracts traded overnight Monday.
There were 18 wheat, 340 corn, 211 soybean, one soymeal, two oat, two wheat puts and 14 corn puts.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 3/4 cent higher, corn 1/2 to one cent lower, soybeans 1/4 cent lower to 1-1/2 cents higher and soymeal $0.10 per ton higher.
